title: Kulich with Honey Glaze and Jelly Filling
description: A traditional Ukrainian sweet bread, filled with a sweet jelly and topped with a honey glaze.
instructions: Slice the kulich in half lengthwise.
Spread the jelly over the bottom half of the kulich.
Place the top half of the kulich over the jelly.
In a small bowl, mix together the honey and 1 tablespoon of water.
Brush the honey glaze over the top of the kulich.
Dust the top of the kulich with cake crumbs.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
Store leftovers in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days.
